name: ce-cal
description: CAL, the cell auth language: parse, compile, explain and verify ce-net capability chains (WebAssembly build of the Rust crate).

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release -p ce-cal-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir pkg ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/ce_cal_wasm.wasm
scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/pkg && cp pkg/* dist/pkg/
